questions.question: The bouquet of roses ___ a pleasant fragrance.
questions.explanation: The head noun of the subject is 'bouquet' (singular). 'Of roses' is a prepositional phrase, so the verb must be 'has'.

description.en: A prepositional phrase between the subject and the verb does not change the number of the subject.
description.id: Frasa preposisi di antara subjek dan kata kerja tidak mengubah jumlah subjek.

wrong_correct.wrong: The bouquet of roses have a pleasant fragrance.
wrong_correct.correct: The bouquet of roses has a pleasant fragrance.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The bouquet', which is singular. The plural noun 'roses' is inside a prepositional phrase and does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The bouquet' yang bersifat tunggal. Kata benda jamak 'roses' berada di dalam frasa preposisi dan tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: The sentence contains a singular head noun followed by a prepositional phrase. The verb agrees with the head noun, not with the noun closest to the verb.

rules.title: 1. Find the Head Noun
rules.explanation: Ask 'What has a pleasant fragrance?' The answer is 'the bouquet', which is singular.
rules.structure: Singular head noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The bouquet of roses has...
The box of chocolates is...

rules.title: 2. Ignore the Prepositional Phrase
rules.explanation: Phrases beginning with 'of', 'with', 'in', 'on', and 'at' do not affect the verb.
rules.structure: Subject + (prepositional phrase) + verb
notes: The plural noun 'roses' does not make the subject plural.

common_mistakes.wrong: The box of chocolates are on the table.
common_mistakes.correct: The box of chocolates is on the table.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'box' is singular, so the verb must be 'is'.

other_examples.sentence: The collection of stamps belongs to my grandfather.
other_examples.translation: Koleksi perangko itu milik kakek saya.

explanation.en: The head noun 'collection' is singular, so the verb is 'belongs'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'collection' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'belongs'.

questions.question: Every one of the participants ___ a certificate at the end of the workshop.
questions.explanation: 'Every one' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so the verb must be 'receives'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Every one, Each, Everyone)

description.en: Indefinite pronouns such as 'every one', 'each', and 'everyone' are grammatically singular and take singular verbs.
description.id: Kata ganti tak tentu seperti 'every one', 'each', dan 'everyone' bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Every one of the participants receive a certificate at the end of the workshop.
wrong_correct.correct: Every one of the participants receives a certificate at the end of the workshop.

explanation.en: The head of the subject is 'Every one', which is singular. The plural noun 'participants' is inside a prepositional phrase and does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'Every one' yang bersifat tunggal. Kata benda jamak 'participants' berada di dalam frasa preposisi dan tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: 'Every one of' is a common pattern in formal English. Even though it refers to many people, the grammatical subject is singular.

rules.title: 1. Every One Is Singular
rules.explanation: 'Every one' means 'each individual one' and takes a singular verb.
rules.structure: Every one + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Every one of the students has a book.
Every one of the rooms is clean.

rules.title: 2. Do Not Confuse with 'All'
rules.explanation: 'All of' can be plural or singular depending on the noun, but 'every one of' is always singular.
rules.structure: All of + plural noun + plural verb (usually)
notes: All of the participants receive certificates.

common_mistakes.wrong: Every one of the players were tired.
common_mistakes.correct: Every one of the players was tired.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Every one' is singular and requires 'was'.

other_examples.sentence: Every one of the rooms has a private bathroom.
other_examples.translation: Setiap kamar memiliki kamar mandi pribadi.

explanation.en: 'Every one' is singular, so the verb is 'has'.
explanation.id: 'Every one' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has'.

questions.question: The pair of shoes ___ too expensive for me to buy.
questions.explanation: The head noun is 'pair' (singular). 'Of shoes' is a prepositional phrase, so the verb is 'is'.

description.en: Expressions like 'a pair of + plural noun' take a singular verb because the head noun 'pair' is singular.
description.id: Ungkapan seperti 'a pair of + kata benda jamak' memakai kata kerja tunggal karena inti subjek 'pair' bersifat tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: The pair of shoes are too expensive for me to buy.
wrong_correct.correct: The pair of shoes is too expensive for me to buy.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The pair', which is singular. 'Of shoes' only describes the pair.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The pair' yang bersifat tunggal. 'Of shoes' hanya menjelaskan pasangan itu.

en.introduction: A 'pair of' expression treats the two items as one unit. The verb agrees with 'pair', not with the plural noun after 'of'.

rules.title: 1. Pair Of = Singular
rules.explanation: This pattern applies to a pair of shoes, a pair of glasses, a pair of trousers, and similar expressions.
rules.structure: A pair of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The pair of shoes is expensive.
A pair of glasses was left on the table.

rules.title: 2. Compare with the Plural Noun Alone
rules.explanation: If you remove 'a pair of' and use the plural noun as the subject, the verb becomes plural.
rules.structure: The shoes + plural verb
notes: The shoes are expensive.

common_mistakes.wrong: A pair of trousers were hanging on the door.
common_mistakes.correct: A pair of trousers was hanging on the door.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'pair' is singular, so the verb must be 'was'.

other_examples.sentence: A pair of gloves was found in the locker room.
other_examples.translation: Sepasang sarung tangan ditemukan di ruang ganti.

explanation.en: The head noun 'pair' is singular, so the verb is 'was'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'pair' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'was'.

questions.question: Neither of the answers ___ correct, so the teacher asked us to try again.
questions.explanation: In formal English, 'neither of' is treated as singular, so the verb is 'was'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Either, Neither, None)

description.en: In formal English, 'neither of' and 'either of' are singular and take singular verbs.
description.id: Dalam bahasa Inggris formal, 'neither of' dan 'either of' bersifat tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither of the answers were correct, so the teacher asked us to try again.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither of the answers was correct, so the teacher asked us to try again.

explanation.en: 'Neither of' means 'not one of the two' and is grammatically singular in formal usage.
explanation.id: 'Neither of' berarti 'bukan salah satu dari dua' dan bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal dalam penggunaan formal.

en.introduction: 'Neither of' refers to two items and means 'not either one'. Because it picks out a single item, it is singular in formal grammar.

rules.title: 1. Neither Of = Singular
rules.explanation: The head word 'neither' controls the verb, not the plural noun after 'of'.
rules.structure: Neither of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Neither of the answers is correct.
Neither of the boys was late.

rules.title: 2. Formal vs Informal Usage
rules.explanation: In informal speech, a plural verb is sometimes heard, but formal writing and exams prefer the singular.
rules.structure: Formal: Neither of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Formal: Neither of them is ready.
Informal: Neither of them are ready. (avoid in exams)

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither of the students have finished the test.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither of the students has finished the test.
common_mistakes.reason: In formal English, 'neither of' takes a singular verb.

other_examples.sentence: Neither of the routes leads to the beach.
other_examples.translation: Tidak ada dari kedua rute itu yang menuju pantai.

explanation.en: 'Neither of' is singular, so the verb is 'leads'.
explanation.id: 'Neither of' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'leads'.

questions.question: The staff ___ required to attend the safety training next week.
questions.explanation: In British English, 'staff' is often treated as plural and takes 'are'. In this context, the members are considered individually.

description.en: 'Staff' is a collective noun. In British English, it often takes a plural verb when the members are considered individually.
description.id: 'Staff' adalah kata benda kolektif. Dalam bahasa Inggris Britania, kata ini sering memakai kata kerja jamak ketika anggotanya dianggap secara individu.

wrong_correct.wrong: The staff is required to attend the safety training next week.
wrong_correct.correct: The staff are required to attend the safety training next week.

explanation.en: 'Staff' refers to the employees as individuals, so the plural verb 'are' is commonly used in British English.
explanation.id: 'Staff' merujuk pada para karyawan sebagai individu, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'are' umum digunakan dalam bahasa Inggris Britania.

en.introduction: Collective nouns like 'staff', 'team', and 'committee' can take singular or plural verbs depending on whether the group is seen as one unit or as individuals.

rules.title: 1. Staff as Individuals = Plural
rules.explanation: When the sentence focuses on the members doing something individually, use a plural verb.
rules.structure: The staff + plural verb
notes: The staff are attending the training.
The staff were given new uniforms.

rules.title: 2. Staff as a Unit = Singular
rules.explanation: When the group acts as one body, a singular verb can be used, especially in American English.
rules.structure: The staff + singular verb
notes: The staff is very efficient.

common_mistakes.wrong: The staff is all wearing their new uniforms.
common_mistakes.correct: The staff are all wearing their new uniforms.
common_mistakes.reason: The plural pronoun 'their' signals individual members, so the verb should be plural.

other_examples.sentence: The staff are complaining about the new schedule.
other_examples.translation: Para staf mengeluh tentang jadwal baru.

explanation.en: The members of the staff are acting individually, so the plural verb 'are' is used.
explanation.id: Para anggota staf bertindak secara individu, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'are' digunakan.

questions.question: The herd of cattle ___ grazing in the field when the storm began.
questions.explanation: The head noun is 'herd' (singular). 'Of cattle' is a prepositional phrase, so the verb is 'was'.

description.en: Collective nouns like 'herd', 'flock', and 'pack' are singular and take singular verbs when the group is viewed as one unit.
description.id: Kata benda kolektif seperti 'herd', 'flock', dan 'pack' bersifat tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal ketika kelompok dilihat sebagai satu kesatuan.

wrong_correct.wrong: The herd of cattle were grazing in the field when the storm began.
wrong_correct.correct: The herd of cattle was grazing in the field when the storm began.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The herd' (singular); 'of cattle' describes the herd but does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The herd' (tunggal); 'of cattle' menjelaskan kawanan itu tetapi tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: Group nouns for animals are usually singular. The prepositional phrase 'of cattle' does not change the number of the subject.

rules.title: 1. Herd, Flock, Pack = Singular
rules.explanation: These nouns name one group, so they take singular verbs.
rules.structure: A herd / flock / pack + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The herd of cattle was grazing.
A flock of birds was flying overhead.

rules.title: 2. Do Not Match the Plural Animal Name
rules.explanation: Words like cattle, sheep, and deer can be plural, but inside 'a herd of' they do not control the verb.
rules.structure: Group noun + of + animal noun + singular verb
notes: The herd of sheep was moving.

common_mistakes.wrong: A flock of birds were flying over the field.
common_mistakes.correct: A flock of birds was flying over the field.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'flock' is singular.

other_examples.sentence: A pack of wolves was howling in the distance.
other_examples.translation: Sekawanan serigala melolong di kejauhan.

explanation.en: The head noun 'pack' is singular, so the verb is 'was'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'pack' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'was'.

questions.question: Not only the players but also the coach ___ disappointed with the result.
questions.explanation: With 'not only ... but also', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'The coach' is singular, so 'was' is correct.

description.en: With 'not only ... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it.
description.id: Dengan 'not only ... but also', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan subjek yang paling dekat dengannya.

wrong_correct.wrong: Not only the players but also the coach were disappointed with the result.
wrong_correct.correct: Not only the players but also the coach was disappointed with the result.

explanation.en: The subject nearest the verb is 'the coach' (singular), so the verb must be 'was'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat dengan kata kerja adalah 'the coach' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'was'.

en.introduction: Correlative conjunctions like 'not only ... but also' follow the proximity rule. The verb agrees with the second subject.

rules.title: 1. Match the Second Subject
rules.explanation: Look at the noun after 'but also'. That noun controls the verb.
rules.structure: Not only A but also B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Not only the players but also the coach was...
Not only the coach but also the players were...

rules.title: 2. Keep the Structure Balanced
rules.explanation: The words after 'not only' and 'but also' should have the same grammatical form.
rules.structure: Not only + noun + but also + noun + verb
notes: Both orders are correct; only the verb changes.

common_mistakes.wrong: Not only the manager but also the employees was informed.
common_mistakes.correct: Not only the manager but also the employees were informed.
common_mistakes.reason: The nearer subject 'employees' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: Not only the teacher but also the students were surprised.
other_examples.translation: Tidak hanya guru tetapi juga para siswa terkejut.

explanation.en: The nearer subject 'the students' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat 'the students' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: The scissors ___ on the table a moment ago.
questions.explanation: 'Scissors' is a plural-only noun and always takes a plural verb, so 'were' is correct.

subtopic.id: Subjek Tunggal dan Jamak (Kata Benda Khusus)

description.en: Some nouns are always plural because they consist of two parts, such as scissors, trousers, glasses, and pliers. They take plural verbs.
description.id: Beberapa kata benda selalu jamak karena terdiri dari dua bagian, seperti scissors, trousers, glasses, dan pliers. Kata kerja yang dipakai jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: The scissors was on the table a moment ago.
wrong_correct.correct: The scissors were on the table a moment ago.

explanation.en: 'Scissors' has no singular form in this sense and is always treated as plural.
explanation.id: 'Scissors' tidak memiliki bentuk tunggal dalam makna ini dan selalu dianggap jamak.

en.introduction: Nouns that name objects made of two joined parts are always plural in English.

rules.title: 1. Always-Plural Nouns
rules.explanation: Scissors, trousers, glasses, pliers, and shorts always take plural verbs.
rules.structure: Plural-only noun + plural verb
notes: The scissors are sharp.
My glasses were broken.

rules.title: 2. Use 'A Pair Of' for Singular Meaning
rules.explanation: If you need a singular subject, use 'a pair of'.
rules.structure: A pair of + plural-only noun + singular verb
notes: A pair of scissors is on the table.

common_mistakes.wrong: The trousers is too long.
common_mistakes.correct: The trousers are too long.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Trousers' is always plural and requires 'are'.

other_examples.sentence: The pliers are in the toolbox.
other_examples.translation: Tang itu ada di kotak perkakas.

explanation.en: 'Pliers' is always plural, so the verb is 'are'.
explanation.id: 'Pliers' selalu jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'are'.

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ willing to work overtime.
questions.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'The employees' is plural, so 'were' is correct.

description.en: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it.
description.id: Dengan 'neither ... nor', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan subjek yang paling dekat dengannya.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither the manager nor the employees was willing to work overtime.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither the manager nor the employees were willing to work overtime.

explanation.en: The nearer subject is 'the employees' (plural), so the verb must be 'were'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat adalah 'the employees' (jamak), sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'were'.

en.introduction: The proximity rule applies to 'neither ... nor'. The second subject controls the verb.

rules.title: 1. Identify the Nearer Subject
rules.explanation: Look at the noun after 'nor'. That noun decides the verb form.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the manager nor the employees were...
Neither the employees nor the manager was...

rules.title: 2. Both Orders Are Possible
rules.explanation: You can change the order, but the verb must always match the second subject.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb matching B
notes: Both versions are grammatically correct.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither the teacher nor the students was ready.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready.
common_mistakes.reason: The nearer subject 'students' is plural.

other_examples.sentence: Neither the driver nor the passengers were injured.
other_examples.translation: Baik pengemudi maupun para penumpang tidak terluka.

explanation.en: The nearer subject 'passengers' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat 'passengers' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: The number of tourists visiting Bali ___ increasing every year.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' is a singular subject, so the verb must be 'is'.

subtopic.en: Quantity Expressions (The number of / A number of)
subtopic.id: Ungkapan Jumlah (The number of / A number of)

description.en: 'The number of + plural noun' is singular because the head noun is 'number'.
description.id: 'The number of + kata benda jamak' bersifat tunggal karena inti subjeknya adalah 'number'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The number of tourists visiting Bali are increasing every year.
wrong_correct.correct: The number of tourists visiting Bali is increasing every year.

explanation.en: The head noun is 'number' (singular), so the verb must be 'is'.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'number' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'is'.

en.introduction: 'The number of' focuses on a single figure. Do not confuse it with 'a number of', which means 'several'.

rules.title: 1. The Number Of = Singular
rules.explanation: The word 'number' is the subject, so the verb is singular.
rules.structure: The number of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The number of students is increasing.
The number of cars has doubled.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with A Number Of
rules.explanation: 'A number of' means 'several' and takes a plural verb.
rules.structure: A number of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: A number of tourists are visiting Bali.

common_mistakes.wrong: The number of books in the library have increased.
common_mistakes.correct: The number of books in the library has increased.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'number' is singular.

other_examples.sentence: The number of applications has risen sharply.
other_examples.translation: Jumlah lamaran telah meningkat tajam.

explanation.en: The singular head noun 'number' takes the singular verb 'has risen'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek tunggal 'number' memakai kata kerja tunggal 'has risen'.

questions.question: Each of the rooms ___ its own air conditioner.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is singular, so the verb must be 'has'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Each, Every, Everyone)

description.en: 'Each of + plural noun' is a singular subject and takes a singular verb.
description.id: 'Each of + kata benda jamak' adalah subjek tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Each of the rooms have its own air conditioner.
wrong_correct.correct: Each of the rooms has its own air conditioner.

explanation.en: The head word 'each' is singular, so the verb must be 'has'.
explanation.id: Inti kata 'each' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'has'.

en.introduction: The pronoun 'each' is always singular, even when it is followed by a plural noun.

rules.title: 1. Each Is Always Singular
rules.explanation: Do not let the plural noun after 'of' confuse you.
rules.structure: Each of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Each of the rooms has...
Each of the students is...

rules.title: 2. Keep Pronouns Consistent
rules.explanation: Use singular pronouns like 'its' or 'his/her' with 'each'.
rules.structure: Each ... + its / his / her
notes: Each of the rooms has its own bathroom.

common_mistakes.wrong: Each of the employees have a badge.
common_mistakes.correct: Each of the employees has a badge.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Each' is singular and requires 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: Each of the houses has a large garden.
other_examples.translation: Setiap rumah memiliki taman yang luas.

explanation.en: 'Each' is singular, so the verb is 'has'.
explanation.id: 'Each' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has'.

questions.question: The jury ___ divided in their opinions about the case.
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'their' shows that the jury members are acting individually, so the plural verb 'were' is correct.

description.en: Collective nouns take a plural verb when the members act individually, often signalled by 'they' or 'their'.
description.id: Kata benda kolektif memakai kata kerja jamak ketika anggotanya bertindak sendiri-sendiri, sering ditandai oleh 'they' atau 'their'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The jury was divided in their opinions about the case.
wrong_correct.correct: The jury were divided in their opinions about the case.

explanation.en: The plural pronoun 'their' shows individual action, so the verb must be plural.
explanation.id: Kata ganti jamak 'their' menunjukkan tindakan individual, sehingga kata kerjanya harus jamak.

en.introduction: When a collective noun refers to members who disagree or act separately, English treats the group as plural.

rules.title: 1. Signals of Individual Action
rules.explanation: Words such as 'their', 'themselves', 'divided', and 'among themselves' indicate plural meaning.
rules.structure: Collective noun + plural verb + their / themselves
notes: The jury were divided in their opinions.
The committee are arguing among themselves.

rules.title: 2. Keep the Sentence Consistent
rules.explanation: Once you use a plural verb, keep the pronouns plural too.
rules.structure: Plural verb + they / their / themselves
notes: Correct: The jury were... their opinions.
Incorrect: The jury was... their opinions.

common_mistakes.wrong: The team was putting on their jackets.
common_mistakes.correct: The team were putting on their jackets.
common_mistakes.reason: The plural pronoun 'their' signals individual action, so the verb should be plural.

other_examples.sentence: The committee are still arguing among themselves.
other_examples.translation: Komite itu masih berdebat di antara mereka sendiri.

explanation.en: 'Among themselves' shows individual action, so the plural verb 'are' is used.
explanation.id: 'Among themselves' menunjukkan tindakan individual, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'are' digunakan.

questions.question: Neither the students nor the teacher ___ present when the bell rang.
questions.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'The teacher' is singular, so 'was' is correct.

description.en: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject.
description.id: Dengan 'neither ... nor', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan subjek yang lebih dekat.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither the students nor the teacher were present when the bell rang.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither the students nor the teacher was present when the bell rang.

explanation.en: The nearer subject is 'the teacher' (singular), so the verb must be 'was'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat adalah 'the teacher' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'was'.

en.introduction: The proximity rule applies to 'neither ... nor'. The second subject controls the verb.

rules.title: 1. Match the Nearer Subject
rules.explanation: Look at the noun after 'nor'. That noun decides the verb form.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the students nor the teacher was...
Neither the teacher nor the students were...

rules.title: 2. Both Orders Are Correct
rules.explanation: The order can be changed, but the verb must always match the second subject.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb matching B
notes: Both versions are grammatically correct.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither the manager nor the assistants was informed.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither the manager nor the assistants were informed.
common_mistakes.reason: The nearer subject 'assistants' is plural.

other_examples.sentence: Neither the players nor the coach was satisfied.
other_examples.translation: Baik para pemain maupun pelatih tidak puas.

explanation.en: The nearer subject 'coach' is singular, so the verb is 'was'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat 'coach' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'was'.

questions.question: The information you provided ___ very helpful.
questions.explanation: 'Information' is an uncountable singular noun, so the verb must be 'was'.

subtopic.id: Kata Benda Tak Terhitung dan Khusus

description.en: Uncountable nouns such as information, advice, furniture, and equipment are grammatically singular and take singular verbs.
description.id: Kata benda tak terhitung seperti information, advice, furniture, dan equipment bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: The information you provided were very helpful.
wrong_correct.correct: The information you provided was very helpful.

explanation.en: 'Information' is uncountable and singular, so the verb must be 'was'.
explanation.id: 'Information' bersifat tak terhitung dan tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'was'.

en.introduction: Uncountable nouns do not have a plural form in this sense and always take singular verbs.

rules.title: 1. Information Is Always Singular
rules.explanation: Do not write 'informations' or use a plural verb with 'information'.
rules.structure: Information + singular verb
notes: The information is useful.
The information was correct.

rules.title: 2. Relative Clauses Do Not Change the Subject
rules.explanation: The clause 'you provided' describes the information but does not affect the verb.
rules.structure: Subject + (relative clause) + singular verb
notes: The information you provided was helpful.

common_mistakes.wrong: The advice were very useful.
common_mistakes.correct: The advice was very useful.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Advice' is uncountable and singular.

other_examples.sentence: The equipment in the lab is very expensive.
other_examples.translation: Peralatan di laboratorium itu sangat mahal.

explanation.en: 'Equipment' is uncountable and singular, so the verb is 'is'.
explanation.id: 'Equipment' bersifat tak terhitung dan tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'is'.

questions.question: One of the boys ___ a broken leg after the accident.
questions.explanation: 'One of' is the singular head of the subject, so the verb is 'has'.

subtopic.en: Indefinite Pronouns (One of, Each of, Neither of)
subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (One of, Each of, Neither of)

description.en: 'One of + plural noun' is a singular subject because the head word is 'one'.
description.id: 'One of + kata benda jamak' adalah subjek tunggal karena inti katanya adalah 'one'.

wrong_correct.wrong: One of the boys have a broken leg after the accident.
wrong_correct.correct: One of the boys has a broken leg after the accident.

explanation.en: The subject is 'One', which is singular, so the verb must be 'has'.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'One' yang bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'has'.

en.introduction: The pattern 'one of + plural noun' is very common in exams. The verb agrees with 'one', not with the plural noun.

rules.title: 1. One Of = Singular
rules.explanation: Even though many boys are mentioned, the sentence talks about only one of them.
rules.structure: One of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: One of the boys has a broken leg.
One of my friends is coming.

rules.title: 2. Same Rule for Each Of and Neither Of
rules.explanation: These expressions follow the same pattern and take singular verbs in formal English.
rules.structure: Each of / Neither of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Each of the rooms has a window.
Neither of the answers is correct.

common_mistakes.wrong: One of the students have won a prize.
common_mistakes.correct: One of the students has won a prize.
common_mistakes.reason: The subject 'one' is singular, so the verb must be 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: One of the windows is broken.
other_examples.translation: Salah satu jendela rusak.

explanation.en: The head of the subject is 'one' (singular), so the verb is 'is'.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'one' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya 'is'.

questions.question: The quality of the food at that restaurant ___ excellent.
questions.explanation: The head noun is 'quality' (singular), so the verb must be 'is'.

description.en: The verb agrees with the head noun of the subject, not with a noun inside a prepositional phrase.
description.id: Kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan inti subjek, bukan dengan kata benda di dalam frasa preposisi.

wrong_correct.wrong: The quality of the food at that restaurant are excellent.
wrong_correct.correct: The quality of the food at that restaurant is excellent.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The quality' (singular); 'of the food at that restaurant' is a prepositional phrase that does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The quality' (tunggal); 'of the food at that restaurant' adalah frasa preposisi yang tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: This is one of the most common traps in subject-verb agreement tests. The verb agrees with the first noun, even when a plural noun appears right before the verb.

rules.title: 1. Identify the Head Noun
rules.explanation: Ask 'What is excellent?' The answer is 'the quality', which is singular.
rules.structure: Head noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The quality of the food is excellent.
The price of these shoes is too high.

rules.title: 2. Common Head Nouns in This Pattern
rules.explanation: Words like quality, number, price, level, amount, and standard are singular and often followed by 'of + plural noun'.
rules.structure: Singular head noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The level of pollution has risen.
The amount of money was insufficient.

common_mistakes.wrong: The price of these houses are very high.
common_mistakes.correct: The price of these houses is very high.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun is 'price' (singular), not 'houses'.

other_examples.sentence: The standard of living in these cities has risen.
other_examples.translation: Standar hidup di kota-kota ini telah meningkat.

explanation.en: The head noun 'standard' is singular, so the verb is 'has risen'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'standard' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has risen'.

questions.question: There ___ a pen and two notebooks on the desk.
questions.explanation: In a 'there is / there are' sentence, the verb agrees with the first noun in the list. 'A pen' is singular, so 'is' is correct.

description.en: In sentences beginning with 'there', the verb agrees with the noun that follows it. When there is a list, the verb usually agrees with the first noun.
description.id: Dalam kalimat yang diawali 'there', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda yang mengikutinya. Bila ada daftar, kata kerja biasanya menyesuaikan dengan kata benda pertama.

wrong_correct.wrong: There are a pen and two notebooks on the desk.
wrong_correct.correct: There is a pen and two notebooks on the desk.

explanation.en: The first noun after the verb is 'a pen' (singular), so 'is' is used in formal English.
explanation.id: Kata benda pertama setelah kata kerja adalah 'a pen' (tunggal), sehingga 'is' digunakan dalam bahasa Inggris formal.

en.introduction: 'There' is not the subject; it only introduces the existence of something. The real subject follows the verb.

rules.title: 1. The Verb Agrees with the First Noun
rules.explanation: If the noun right after the verb is singular, use 'is'. If it is plural, use 'are'.
rules.structure: There + is / are + noun + place
notes: There is a pen on the desk.
There are two books on the desk.

rules.title: 2. Lists Follow the First Noun
rules.explanation: In formal English, the verb agrees with the first item in the list.
rules.structure: There + verb + first noun + and + second noun
notes: There is a pen and two notebooks...
There are two notebooks and a pen...

common_mistakes.wrong: There was many people at the concert.
common_mistakes.correct: There were many people at the concert.
common_mistakes.reason: 'People' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: There is a chair and a table in the room.
other_examples.translation: Ada sebuah kursi dan sebuah meja di ruangan itu.

explanation.en: The first noun 'a chair' is singular, so 'is' is correct.
explanation.id: Kata benda pertama 'a chair' bersifat tunggal, sehingga 'is' benar.

questions.question: Most of the furniture in the old house ___ damaged by the flood.
questions.explanation: 'Furniture' is an uncountable singular noun, so the verb after 'most of' must be 'was'.

description.en: With 'most of', the verb agrees with the noun after 'of'. Uncountable nouns take singular verbs.
description.id: Dengan 'most of', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda setelah 'of'. Kata benda tak terhitung memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Most of the furniture in the old house were damaged by the flood.
wrong_correct.correct: Most of the furniture in the old house was damaged by the flood.

explanation.en: 'Furniture' is uncountable and singular, so the verb must be 'was'.
explanation.id: 'Furniture' bersifat tak terhitung dan tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'was'.

en.introduction: 'Most of' is a quantifier, not the subject. The subject is the noun after 'of', and uncountable nouns are singular.

rules.title: 1. Uncountable Noun After Of = Singular
rules.explanation: Nouns such as furniture, equipment, luggage, and information are uncountable.
rules.structure: Most of + uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: Most of the furniture was damaged.
Most of the information is useful.

rules.title: 2. Plural Noun After Of = Plural
rules.explanation: If the noun after 'of' is a plural countable noun, use a plural verb.
rules.structure: Most of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: Most of the chairs were damaged.

common_mistakes.wrong: Most of the equipment were replaced.
common_mistakes.correct: Most of the equipment was replaced.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Equipment' is uncountable and singular.

other_examples.sentence: Some of the luggage was lost at the airport.
other_examples.translation: Sebagian barang bawaan hilang di bandara.

explanation.en: 'Luggage' is uncountable, so the verb is singular: 'was'.
explanation.id: 'Luggage' bersifat tak terhitung, sehingga kata kerjanya tunggal: 'was'.

questions.question: The teacher, as well as the students, ___ excited about the field trip.
questions.explanation: 'As well as the students' is an interrupting phrase. The real subject is 'The teacher' (singular), so the verb is 'is'.

description.en: Phrases such as 'as well as', 'along with', and 'together with' do not change the number of the subject.
description.id: Frasa seperti 'as well as', 'along with', dan 'together with' tidak mengubah jumlah subjek.

wrong_correct.wrong: The teacher, as well as the students, are excited about the field trip.
wrong_correct.correct: The teacher, as well as the students, is excited about the field trip.

explanation.en: 'As well as' is not the conjunction 'and'. The subject remains 'The teacher', which is singular.
explanation.id: 'As well as' bukan konjungsi 'and'. Subjeknya tetap 'The teacher' yang bersifat tunggal.

en.introduction: Some phrases look like they join two subjects, but they only add extra information about the first subject.

rules.title: 1. Phrases That Do Not Change the Subject
rules.explanation: As well as, along with, together with, accompanied by, and in addition to are not conjunctions.
rules.structure: Singular subject + , as well as + phrase, + singular verb
notes: The teacher, as well as the students, is coming.
The mayor, together with his advisors, was present.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with And
rules.explanation: Only 'and' truly joins two subjects into a plural one.
rules.structure: Subject A + and + Subject B + plural verb
notes: The teacher and the students are excited.

common_mistakes.wrong: The manager, as well as the employees, were surprised.
common_mistakes.correct: The manager, as well as the employees, was surprised.
common_mistakes.reason: 'As well as' does not join the subjects; the singular 'manager' controls the verb.

other_examples.sentence: The president, accompanied by his ministers, has arrived.
other_examples.translation: Presiden, didampingi para menterinya, telah tiba.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The president' (singular); 'accompanied by his ministers' is only an interrupting phrase.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The president' (tunggal); 'accompanied by his ministers' hanya frasa penyela.

questions.question: The keys to the main office ___ kept in the security room.
questions.explanation: The head noun is 'keys' (plural), so the verb must be 'are'.

description.en: A prepositional phrase between the subject and the verb does not change the number of the subject.
description.id: Frasa preposisi di antara subjek dan kata kerja tidak mengubah jumlah subjek.

wrong_correct.wrong: The keys to the main office is kept in the security room.
wrong_correct.correct: The keys to the main office are kept in the security room.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The keys' (plural). 'To the main office' is a prepositional phrase and does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The keys' (jamak). 'To the main office' adalah frasa preposisi dan tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: The verb agrees with the head noun of the subject, not with a noun inside a prepositional phrase.

rules.title: 1. Find the Head Noun
rules.explanation: Ask 'What are kept?' The answer is 'the keys', which is plural.
rules.structure: Plural head noun + (prepositional phrase) + plural verb
notes: The keys to the office are kept...
The books on the shelf are new.

rules.title: 2. Ignore the Prepositional Phrase
rules.explanation: Phrases beginning with 'to', 'of', 'on', 'in', and 'with' do not affect the verb.
rules.structure: Subject + (prepositional phrase) + verb
notes: The singular noun 'office' does not make the subject singular.

common_mistakes.wrong: The colour of the walls are unusual.
common_mistakes.correct: The colour of the walls is unusual.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'colour' is singular.

other_examples.sentence: The documents in the folder are confidential.
other_examples.translation: Dokumen-dokumen di dalam map itu bersifat rahasia.

explanation.en: The head noun 'documents' is plural, so the verb is 'are'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'documents' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'are'.

questions.question: Everybody in the audience ___ clapping after the performance.
questions.explanation: 'Everybody' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so the verb must be 'was'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Everyone, Everybody, Somebody)

description.en: Indefinite pronouns ending in -body are singular and take singular verbs.
description.id: Kata ganti tak tentu berakhiran -body bersifat tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Everybody in the audience were clapping after the performance.
wrong_correct.correct: Everybody in the audience was clapping after the performance.

explanation.en: 'Everybody' is singular; the phrase 'in the audience' is only a modifier.
explanation.id: 'Everybody' bersifat tunggal; frasa 'in the audience' hanya pewatas.

en.introduction: 'Everybody' means 'every person', but grammatically it is treated as one singular unit.

rules.title: 1. -Body Pronouns Are Singular
rules.explanation: Everybody, somebody, anybody, and nobody all take singular verbs.
rules.structure: Everybody / Somebody / Nobody + singular verb
notes: Everybody was clapping.
Nobody knows the answer.

rules.title: 2. Prepositional Phrases Do Not Change the Subject
rules.explanation: A phrase beginning with 'in', 'at', 'of', or 'with' describes the subject but does not change its number.
rules.structure: Everybody + (prepositional phrase) + singular verb
notes: 'In the audience' is a modifier, not part of the grammatical subject.

common_mistakes.wrong: Everybody in the class have finished the test.
common_mistakes.correct: Everybody in the class has finished the test.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Everybody' is singular, so the verb must be 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: Nobody in the office knows where the file is.
other_examples.translation: Tidak ada seorang pun di kantor yang tahu di mana berkas itu.

explanation.en: 'Nobody' is singular and takes the singular verb 'knows'.
explanation.id: 'Nobody' bersifat tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal 'knows'.

questions.question: A number of issues ___ raised during the meeting.
questions.explanation: 'A number of' means 'several', so it takes a plural verb: 'were'.

subtopic.en: Quantity Expressions (The number of / A number of)
subtopic.id: Ungkapan Jumlah (The number of / A number of)

description.en: 'A number of + plural noun' functions as a plural subject and takes a plural verb.
description.id: 'A number of + kata benda jamak' berfungsi sebagai subjek jamak dan memakai kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: A number of issues was raised during the meeting.
wrong_correct.correct: A number of issues were raised during the meeting.

explanation.en: 'A number of' is a quantifier meaning 'several', so the plural verb 'were' is required.
explanation.id: 'A number of' adalah pembilang yang berarti 'beberapa', sehingga kata kerja jamak 'were' diperlukan.

en.introduction: Compare 'a number of' with 'the number of'. Here the article 'a' signals the meaning 'several'.

rules.title: 1. A Number Of = Several
rules.explanation: This phrase is a quantifier, not the subject itself. The plural noun after it controls the verb.
rules.structure: A number of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: A number of issues were raised.
A number of people have complained.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with The Number Of
rules.explanation: 'The number of' focuses on a single figure and is singular.
rules.structure: The number of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The number of issues was surprising.

common_mistakes.wrong: A number of problems has been reported.
common_mistakes.correct: A number of problems have been reported.
common_mistakes.reason: 'A number of' behaves like 'several' and needs a plural verb.

other_examples.sentence: A number of shops in the mall were closed yesterday.
other_examples.translation: Sejumlah toko di mal itu tutup kemarin.

explanation.en: 'A number of shops' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: 'A number of shops' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: The committee ___ its final report yesterday.
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'its' shows that the committee is treated as one unit, so the singular verb 'has submitted' is correct.

description.en: Collective nouns take a singular verb when the group acts as a single unit, often signalled by 'its'.
description.id: Kata benda kolektif memakai kata kerja tunggal ketika kelompok bertindak sebagai satu kesatuan, sering ditandai oleh 'its'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The committee have submitted its final report yesterday.
wrong_correct.correct: The committee has submitted its final report yesterday.

explanation.en: The singular pronoun 'its' requires a singular verb, so 'has submitted' is correct.
explanation.id: Kata ganti tunggal 'its' memerlukan kata kerja tunggal, sehingga 'has submitted' yang benar.

en.introduction: A collective noun can be singular or plural. The pronoun in the sentence is a strong clue.

rules.title: 1. Singular Verb with Its
rules.explanation: When the group is seen as one body, use a singular verb and singular pronouns.
rules.structure: Collective noun + singular verb + its
notes: The committee has submitted its report.
The company has changed its policy.

rules.title: 2. Plural Verb with Their
rules.explanation: When the members are seen individually, use a plural verb and plural pronouns.
rules.structure: Collective noun + plural verb + their
notes: The committee have submitted their reports.

common_mistakes.wrong: The team have won its third championship.
common_mistakes.correct: The team has won its third championship.
common_mistakes.reason: The singular pronoun 'its' requires a singular verb.

other_examples.sentence: The jury has reached its verdict.
other_examples.translation: Juri telah mencapai putusannya.

explanation.en: The singular pronoun 'its' shows the jury is treated as one unit, so the verb is 'has'.
explanation.id: Kata ganti tunggal 'its' menunjukkan juri dianggap satu kesatuan, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has'.

questions.question: Few of the students ___ interested in the optional lecture.
questions.explanation: 'Few of' refers to a plural countable noun ('students'), so the verb must be 'were'.

description.en: Quantifiers that refer to plural countable nouns (few, many, several, both) take plural verbs.
description.id: Pembilang yang merujuk pada kata benda jamak terhitung (few, many, several, both) memakai kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: Few of the students was interested in the optional lecture.
wrong_correct.correct: Few of the students were interested in the optional lecture.

explanation.en: 'Few of' always refers to more than one countable item, so the verb is plural.
explanation.id: 'Few of' selalu merujuk pada lebih dari satu benda terhitung, sehingga kata kerjanya jamak.

en.introduction: 'Few' means 'not many'. Because it refers to several individual items, it behaves like a plural subject.

rules.title: 1. Plural Quantifiers
rules.explanation: Few, a few, many, several, and both all take plural verbs.
rules.structure: Few / Many / Several / Both + of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: Few of them were present.
Many of the students have left.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with Little and Much
rules.explanation: Quantifiers used with uncountable nouns (little, a little, much) take singular verbs.
rules.structure: Little / Much + of + uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: Little of the information was useful.

common_mistakes.wrong: Several of the players was injured.
common_mistakes.correct: Several of the players were injured.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Several' is always plural and needs a plural verb.

other_examples.sentence: Many of the applicants have already been interviewed.
other_examples.translation: Banyak pelamar telah diwawancarai.

explanation.en: 'Many of' takes a plural verb because it refers to several countable people.
explanation.id: 'Many of' memakai kata kerja jamak karena merujuk pada beberapa orang terhitung.

questions.question: Every student and every teacher ___ required to wear an identification badge.
questions.explanation: When 'every' is repeated before each noun joined by 'and', the subject is singular, so the verb is 'is'.

description.en: When 'each' or 'every' is used before both nouns joined by 'and', the subject is considered singular.
description.id: Ketika 'each' atau 'every' dipakai sebelum kedua kata benda yang digabungkan dengan 'and', subjeknya dianggap tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Every student and every teacher are required to wear an identification badge.
wrong_correct.correct: Every student and every teacher is required to wear an identification badge.

explanation.en: The repeated 'every' makes the subject singular, so the singular verb 'is' is required.
explanation.id: Pengulangan 'every' membuat subjek bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'is' diperlukan.

en.introduction: Normally 'and' produces a plural subject. However, when 'each' or 'every' comes before both nouns, the sentence emphasises each individual separately.

rules.title: 1. Every ... and Every = Singular
rules.explanation: The repetition of the determiner turns the whole subject into a singular idea.
rules.structure: Every + noun + and + every + noun + singular verb
notes: Every student and every teacher is required.
Each boy and each girl has a book.

rules.title: 2. Compare with Plain And
rules.explanation: Without the repeated determiners, the subject is plural.
rules.structure: Noun + and + noun + plural verb
notes: The student and the teacher are required to wear badges.

common_mistakes.wrong: Each member and each guest were welcomed.
common_mistakes.correct: Each member and each guest was welcomed.
common_mistakes.reason: The repeated 'each' makes the subject singular.

other_examples.sentence: Every room and every corridor has been cleaned.
other_examples.translation: Setiap kamar dan setiap koridor telah dibersihkan.

explanation.en: The repeated 'every' makes the subject singular, so the verb is 'has been'.
explanation.id: Pengulangan 'every' membuat subjek tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has been'.

questions.question: The police ___ arrested a suspect in connection with the robbery.
questions.explanation: 'Police' is a plural collective noun and always takes a plural verb: 'have arrested'.

description.en: 'Police' is always plural in English and takes a plural verb.
description.id: 'Police' selalu jamak dalam bahasa Inggris dan memakai kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: The police has arrested a suspect in connection with the robbery.
wrong_correct.correct: The police have arrested a suspect in connection with the robbery.

explanation.en: 'Police' has no singular form in this sense and is always treated as plural.
explanation.id: 'Police' tidak memiliki bentuk tunggal dalam makna ini dan selalu dianggap jamak.

en.introduction: 'Police' refers to the members of a police force as a group of individuals. It always takes a plural verb.

rules.title: 1. Police Is Always Plural
rules.explanation: Use plural verbs with 'police': are, were, have, etc.
rules.structure: The police + plural verb
notes: The police are investigating.
The police have arrested the suspect.

rules.title: 2. Singular Alternatives
rules.explanation: If you need a singular subject, use 'a police officer' or 'a policeman'.
rules.structure: A police officer + singular verb
notes: A police officer is investigating the case.

common_mistakes.wrong: The police is coming.
common_mistakes.correct: The police are coming.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Police' is always plural and requires 'are'.

other_examples.sentence: The police were called to the scene immediately.
other_examples.translation: Polisi dipanggil ke lokasi kejadian segera.

explanation.en: 'Police' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: 'Police' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: Ten thousand rupiah ___ enough to buy a meal at the school canteen.
questions.explanation: A sum of money is treated as a single amount, so the verb is 'is'.

description.en: Expressions of money, time, distance, and weight are treated as a single amount and take singular verbs.
description.id: Ungkapan uang, waktu, jarak, dan berat dianggap sebagai satu jumlah dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Ten thousand rupiah are enough to buy a meal at the school canteen.
wrong_correct.correct: Ten thousand rupiah is enough to buy a meal at the school canteen.

explanation.en: The phrase names one amount of money, not ten thousand separate rupiah, so the verb must be singular.
explanation.id: Frasa itu menamai satu jumlah uang, bukan sepuluh ribu rupiah terpisah, sehingga kata kerjanya harus tunggal.

en.introduction: When a number and a unit of money form one amount, the whole expression is singular in grammar.

rules.title: 1. One Amount = Singular Verb
rules.explanation: Money, time, distance, and weight expressions are considered one unit.
rules.structure: Number + unit + singular verb
notes: Ten thousand rupiah is enough.
Fifty kilograms is too heavy.
Two hours is enough.

rules.title: 2. When the Items Are Separate
rules.explanation: If you are talking about separate individual items rather than one amount, use a plural verb.
rules.structure: Number + plural noun (separate items) + plural verb
notes: Ten thousand rupiah coins were scattered on the floor.

common_mistakes.wrong: Twenty dollars are too much for a cup of coffee.
common_mistakes.correct: Twenty dollars is too much for a cup of coffee.
common_mistakes.reason: Money is treated as one amount, so the verb is singular.

other_examples.sentence: Three hours is not enough to finish the exam.
other_examples.translation: Tiga jam tidak cukup untuk menyelesaikan ujian itu.

explanation.en: 'Three hours' is one period of time, so the singular verb 'is' is correct.
explanation.id: 'Three hours' adalah satu rentang waktu, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'is' benar.

questions.question: The news about the merger ___ surprising to everyone.
questions.explanation: 'News' is an uncountable singular noun, so the verb must be 'was'.

subtopic.id: Kata Benda Tak Terhitung dan Khusus

description.en: 'News' is an uncountable singular noun and always takes a singular verb.
description.id: 'News' adalah kata benda tunggal tak terhitung dan selalu memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: The news about the merger were surprising to everyone.
wrong_correct.correct: The news about the merger was surprising to everyone.

explanation.en: 'News' ends in -s but is singular, and 'about the merger' is only a modifier.
explanation.id: 'News' berakhiran -s tetapi bersifat tunggal, dan 'about the merger' hanya pewatas.

en.introduction: A few English nouns look plural because of a final -s but are actually singular. 'News' is the most common example.

rules.title: 1. News Is Singular
rules.explanation: 'News' has no plural form and always takes a singular verb.
rules.structure: The news + singular verb
notes: The news is good.
The news was shocking.

rules.title: 2. Modifiers Do Not Change It
rules.explanation: A phrase like 'about the merger' only describes the news, so the verb stays singular.
rules.structure: The news + (modifier) + singular verb
notes: The news from the capital is worrying.

common_mistakes.wrong: The news were announced this morning.
common_mistakes.correct: The news was announced this morning.
common_mistakes.reason: 'News' is singular and requires 'was'.

other_examples.sentence: The news from the front line is not good.
other_examples.translation: Kabar dari garis depan tidak baik.

explanation.en: Despite ending in -s, 'news' is singular and takes 'is'.
explanation.id: Meskipun berakhiran -s, 'news' bersifat tunggal dan memakai 'is'.

questions.question: Neither of the two proposals ___ acceptable to the board.
questions.explanation: In formal English, 'neither of' is singular, so the verb is 'was'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Either, Neither, None)

description.en: 'Neither of + plural noun' is singular in formal English and takes a singular verb.
description.id: 'Neither of + kata benda jamak' bersifat tunggal dalam bahasa Inggris formal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither of the two proposals were acceptable to the board.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither of the two proposals was acceptable to the board.

explanation.en: 'Neither of' means 'not one of the two' and is grammatically singular in formal usage.
explanation.id: 'Neither of' berarti 'bukan salah satu dari dua' dan bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal dalam penggunaan formal.

en.introduction: 'Neither of' refers to two items and means 'not either one'. It is singular in formal grammar.

rules.title: 1. Neither Of = Singular
rules.explanation: The head word 'neither' controls the verb, not the plural noun after 'of'.
rules.structure: Neither of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Neither of the proposals is acceptable.
Neither of the boys was late.

rules.title: 2. Formal vs Informal Usage
rules.explanation: In informal speech, a plural verb is sometimes heard, but formal writing and exams prefer the singular.
rules.structure: Formal: Neither of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Formal: Neither of them is ready.
Informal: Neither of them are ready. (avoid in exams)

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither of the students have finished the test.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither of the students has finished the test.
common_mistakes.reason: In formal English, 'neither of' takes a singular verb.

other_examples.sentence: Neither of the routes leads to the beach.
other_examples.translation: Tidak ada dari kedua rute itu yang menuju pantai.

explanation.en: 'Neither of' is singular, so the verb is 'leads'.
explanation.id: 'Neither of' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'leads'.

questions.question: The flock of sheep ___ moving slowly across the road.
questions.explanation: The head noun is 'flock' (singular), so the verb is 'was'.

description.en: Collective nouns like 'flock' take a singular verb when the group is seen as one unit.
description.id: Kata benda kolektif seperti 'flock' memakai kata kerja tunggal ketika kelompok dilihat sebagai satu kesatuan.

wrong_correct.wrong: The flock of sheep were moving slowly across the road.
wrong_correct.correct: The flock of sheep was moving slowly across the road.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The flock' (singular); 'of sheep' describes the flock but does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The flock' (tunggal); 'of sheep' menjelaskan kawanan itu tetapi tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: Group nouns for animals are usually singular. The prepositional phrase 'of sheep' does not change the number of the subject.

rules.title: 1. Flock, Herd, Pack = Singular
rules.explanation: These nouns name one group, so they take singular verbs.
rules.structure: A flock / herd / pack + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The flock of sheep was moving.
A herd of cattle was grazing.

rules.title: 2. Do Not Match the Plural Animal Name
rules.explanation: Words like sheep and cattle can be plural, but inside 'a flock of' they do not control the verb.
rules.structure: Group noun + of + animal noun + singular verb
notes: The flock of sheep was moving.

common_mistakes.wrong: A flock of birds were flying over the field.
common_mistakes.correct: A flock of birds was flying over the field.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'flock' is singular.

other_examples.sentence: A pack of wolves was howling in the distance.
other_examples.translation: Sekawanan serigala melolong di kejauhan.

explanation.en: The head noun 'pack' is singular, so the verb is 'was'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'pack' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'was'.

questions.question: Half of the students in the class ___ absent today.
questions.explanation: The noun after 'of' is 'students' (plural), so the verb must be 'were'.

subtopic.en: Fractions and Quantifiers (Half of, Two-thirds of)
subtopic.id: Pecahan dan Pembilang (Half of, Two-thirds of)

description.en: With fractions, the verb agrees with the noun after 'of'.
description.id: Dengan pecahan, kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda setelah 'of'.

wrong_correct.wrong: Half of the students in the class was absent today.
wrong_correct.correct: Half of the students in the class were absent today.

explanation.en: 'Students' is plural, so the plural verb 'were' is needed. The phrase 'in the class' is only a modifier.
explanation.id: 'Students' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'were' diperlukan. Frasa 'in the class' hanya pewatas.

en.introduction: A fraction like 'half of' is a quantifier. The real subject is the noun that follows, and that noun decides the verb form.

rules.title: 1. Plural Noun After Of = Plural Verb
rules.explanation: Countable plural nouns take plural verbs after fractions and quantifiers.
rules.structure: Fraction + of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: Half of the students were absent.
Two-thirds of the books were damaged.

rules.title: 2. Watch Out for Interrupting Phrases
rules.explanation: Phrases like 'in the class' come after the noun but do not change the agreement.
rules.structure: Fraction + of + noun + (phrase) + verb
notes: 'In the class' can be removed without affecting the verb.

common_mistakes.wrong: Most of the homework have been corrected.
common_mistakes.correct: Most of the homework has been corrected.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Homework' is uncountable, so the singular verb 'has' is required.

other_examples.sentence: Half of the members have already voted.
other_examples.translation: Setengah dari anggota telah memberikan suara.

explanation.en: 'Members' is plural, so the plural verb 'have' is correct.
explanation.id: 'Members' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'have' benar.

questions.question: None of the equipment in the laboratory ___ working properly.
questions.explanation: 'Equipment' is an uncountable singular noun, so the verb after 'none of' must be 'was'.

description.en: With 'none of', the verb agrees with the noun after 'of'. Uncountable nouns take singular verbs.
description.id: Dengan 'none of', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda setelah 'of'. Kata benda tak terhitung memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: None of the equipment in the laboratory were working properly.
wrong_correct.correct: None of the equipment in the laboratory was working properly.

explanation.en: 'Equipment' is uncountable and singular, so the verb must be 'was'.
explanation.id: 'Equipment' bersifat tak terhitung dan tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'was'.

en.introduction: 'None of' takes its number from the noun that follows. With uncountable nouns it is always singular.

rules.title: 1. None Of + Uncountable = Singular
rules.explanation: Nouns such as equipment, furniture, money, and information are uncountable and require a singular verb.
rules.structure: None of + uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: None of the equipment was working.
None of the information was accurate.

rules.title: 2. None Of + Plural Noun
rules.explanation: With plural countable nouns, both singular and plural verbs occur; formal writing commonly uses the singular.
rules.structure: None of + plural noun + singular or plural verb
notes: None of the students was late. (formal)
None of the students were late. (also accepted)

common_mistakes.wrong: None of the furniture are new.
common_mistakes.correct: None of the furniture is new.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Furniture' is uncountable, so the verb must be singular.

other_examples.sentence: None of the water has been wasted.
other_examples.translation: Tidak ada air yang terbuang.

explanation.en: 'Water' is uncountable, so the singular verb 'has' is used.
explanation.id: 'Water' bersifat tak terhitung, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'has' digunakan.

questions.question: Click the incorrect part of the sentence and type the correct form.
questions.sentence: The collection of rare coins have been donated to the museum.
questions.explanation: The head noun of the subject is 'collection' (singular), so the verb must be 'has been donated'.

description.en: In 'the collection of + plural noun', the head noun 'collection' is singular and controls the verb.
description.id: Dalam 'the collection of + kata benda jamak', inti subjek 'collection' bersifat tunggal dan menentukan kata kerja.

wrong_correct.wrong: The collection of rare coins have been donated to the museum.
wrong_correct.correct: The collection of rare coins has been donated to the museum.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The collection', which is singular, so the verb must be 'has been donated'.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The collection' yang bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'has been donated'.

en.introduction: When a singular noun such as collection, box, set, or group is followed by 'of + plural noun', the verb agrees with the first noun.

rules.title: 1. The First Noun Is the Subject
rules.explanation: Words like collection, box, set, and group are the grammatical head of the subject.
rules.structure: The collection / box / set + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The collection of coins has been donated.
The box of chocolates is on the table.

rules.title: 2. Cover the 'of' Phrase
rules.explanation: Read only the beginning and the verb; that makes the correct agreement obvious.
rules.structure: The collection ... has been donated.
notes: This quick test prevents most errors of this type.

common_mistakes.wrong: The set of instructions are confusing.
common_mistakes.correct: The set of instructions is confusing.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'set' is singular, so the verb must be 'is'.

other_examples.sentence: The box of old photographs was found in the attic.
other_examples.translation: Kotak berisi foto-foto lama itu ditemukan di loteng.

explanation.en: The head noun 'box' is singular, so the verb is 'was'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'box' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'was'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect part of the sentence and type the correct form.
questions.sentence: Neither the principal nor the teachers was present at the meeting.
tokens: Neither the principal nor the teachers
questions.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'The teachers' is plural, so 'were present' is correct.

description.en: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it.
description.id: Dengan 'neither ... nor', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan subjek yang paling dekat dengannya.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither the principal nor the teachers was present at the meeting.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither the principal nor the teachers were present at the meeting.

explanation.en: The nearer subject is 'the teachers' (plural), so the verb must be 'were present'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat adalah 'the teachers' (jamak), sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'were present'.

en.introduction: The proximity rule applies to 'neither ... nor'. The second subject controls the verb.

rules.title: 1. Match the Second Subject
rules.explanation: Look at the noun after 'nor'. That noun decides the verb form.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the principal nor the teachers were...
Neither the teachers nor the principal was...

rules.title: 2. Both Orders Are Correct
rules.explanation: The order can be changed, but the verb must always match the second subject.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb matching B
notes: Both versions are grammatically correct.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither the manager nor the assistants was informed.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither the manager nor the assistants were informed.
common_mistakes.reason: The nearer subject 'assistants' is plural.

other_examples.sentence: Neither the driver nor the passengers were injured.
other_examples.translation: Baik pengemudi maupun para penumpang tidak terluka.

explanation.en: The nearer subject 'passengers' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat 'passengers' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect part of the sentence and type the correct form.
questions.sentence: Each of the volunteers have received a training certificate.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so the verb must be 'has received'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Each, Every, Everyone)

description.en: 'Each of + plural noun' is a singular subject and requires a singular verb.
description.id: 'Each of + kata benda jamak' adalah subjek tunggal dan memerlukan kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Each of the volunteers have received a training certificate.
wrong_correct.correct: Each of the volunteers has received a training certificate.

explanation.en: The head of the subject is 'Each', which is singular, so 'has received' is correct.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'Each' yang bersifat tunggal, sehingga 'has received' yang benar.

en.introduction: This is a classic exam error. The plural noun right before the verb tempts the writer to use a plural verb, but the true subject is 'each'.

rules.title: 1. Each Is Always Singular
rules.explanation: Regardless of how many items follow, 'each' takes a singular verb.
rules.structure: Each of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Each of the volunteers has received a certificate.
Each of the houses has a garden.

rules.title: 2. The Noun After Of Is Not the Subject
rules.explanation: 'Of the volunteers' is a prepositional phrase; it describes the group but does not control the verb.
rules.structure: Each + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Remove 'of the volunteers' and you get 'Each ... has received'.

common_mistakes.wrong: Each of the books have a red cover.
common_mistakes.correct: Each of the books has a red cover.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Each' is singular and requires 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: Each of the employees has signed the contract.
other_examples.translation: Setiap karyawan telah menandatangani kontrak.

explanation.en: 'Each' is singular, so the verb is 'has signed'.
explanation.id: 'Each' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has signed'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect part of the sentence and type the correct form.
questions.sentence: The members of the choir is rehearsing for the concert.
questions.explanation: The head noun of the subject is 'members' (plural), so the verb must be 'are rehearsing'.

description.en: In 'the members of the choir', the head noun is the plural 'members', not the singular 'choir'.
description.id: Dalam 'the members of the choir', inti subjeknya adalah 'members' yang jamak, bukan 'choir' yang tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: The members of the choir is rehearsing for the concert.
wrong_correct.correct: The members of the choir are rehearsing for the concert.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The members' (plural). The word 'choir' is inside a prepositional phrase and cannot control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The members' (jamak). Kata 'choir' berada di dalam frasa preposisi dan tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: Be careful with expressions like 'the members of the choir'. The collective noun appears last, but the subject is the plural word 'members'.

rules.title: 1. Plural Head Noun = Plural Verb
rules.explanation: Words such as members, players, and employees are plural and take plural verbs.
rules.structure: The members / players / employees + of + group noun + plural verb
notes: The members of the choir are rehearsing.
The players of the team were tired.

rules.title: 2. Compare with the Collective Noun Alone
rules.explanation: When the collective noun is the whole subject, it can be singular; when a plural noun heads the phrase, the verb is plural.
rules.structure: The choir is... / The members of the choir are...
notes: The choir is rehearsing.
The members of the choir are rehearsing.

common_mistakes.wrong: The players of the national team was awarded a prize.
common_mistakes.correct: The players of the national team were awarded a prize.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'players' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: The employees of the company are demanding higher wages.
other_examples.translation: Para karyawan perusahaan itu menuntut upah yang lebih tinggi.

explanation.en: The head noun 'employees' is plural, so the verb is 'are'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'employees' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'are'.

questions.question: Which set of words correctly completes the passage?
questions.passage: The library at our school ___ (i) ___ open from Monday to Saturday. Students who borrow books ___ (ii) ___ to return them within two weeks. Neither the librarian nor the assistants ___ (iii) ___ allowed to accept late returns without a fine.
questions.explanation: The head noun 'library' is singular (is); 'students' is plural (are required); with 'neither ... nor' the nearer subject 'assistants' is plural (are allowed).

description.en: In longer texts, several agreement rules may appear together: head nouns with prepositional phrases, plural subjects, and the proximity rule with 'neither ... nor'.
description.id: Dalam teks yang lebih panjang, beberapa aturan kesesuaian dapat muncul bersamaan: inti subjek dengan frasa preposisi, subjek jamak, dan aturan kedekatan dengan 'neither ... nor'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The library at our school are open from Monday to Saturday.
wrong_correct.correct: The library at our school is open from Monday to Saturday.

explanation.en: The head noun 'library' is singular; 'at our school' is a prepositional phrase.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'library' bersifat tunggal; 'at our school' adalah frasa preposisi.

en.introduction: This passage tests three different agreement rules at once. Work through each blank separately.

rules.title: 1. Blank (i): Singular Head Noun
rules.explanation: The subject is 'The library at our school'. The head noun 'library' is singular, so the verb is 'is'.
rules.structure: The library + (prepositional phrase) + is
notes: The plural noun 'school' does not affect the verb.

rules.title: 2. Blank (ii): Plural Subject
rules.explanation: The subject is 'Students who borrow books'. The head noun 'students' is plural, so the verb is 'are required'.
rules.structure: Students + (relative clause) + plural verb
notes: The relative clause 'who borrow books' describes the students.

rules.title: 3. Blank (iii): Proximity Rule
rules.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject, 'the assistants', which is plural, so 'are allowed' is correct.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: 'The assistants' is the nearest subject and it is plural.

common_mistakes.wrong: Choosing one verb form for all three blanks.
common_mistakes.correct: Check each blank separately using its own subject.
common_mistakes.reason: Different clauses in the same passage can follow different agreement rules.

other_examples.sentence: The museum in those towns is open daily, and neither the guards nor the guides are allowed to smoke inside.
other_examples.translation: Museum di kota-kota itu buka setiap hari, dan baik penjaga maupun pemandu tidak diperbolehkan merokok di dalam.

explanation.en: The singular head noun 'museum' takes 'is', and the nearer subject 'guides' takes 'are'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek tunggal 'museum' memakai 'is', dan subjek terdekat 'guides' memakai 'are'.

questions.question: Which set of words correctly completes the passage?
questions.passage: The committee ___ (i) ___ already reached its decision about the new budget. Each of the members ___ (ii) ___ prepared a short report. Unfortunately, neither the chairman nor the treasurer ___ (iii) ___ able to attend the final meeting.
questions.explanation: The committee acts as a unit with 'its' (has); 'each of' is singular (has); with 'neither ... nor' the nearer subject 'the treasurer' is singular (was).

description.en: This passage combines collective nouns, indefinite pronouns, and correlative conjunctions, all of which affect subject-verb agreement.
description.id: Bacaan ini menggabungkan kata benda kolektif, kata ganti tak tentu, dan konjungsi korelatif, yang semuanya memengaruhi kesesuaian subjek dan kata kerja.

wrong_correct.wrong: Each of the members have prepared a short report.
wrong_correct.correct: Each of the members has prepared a short report.

explanation.en: 'Each' is the singular head of the subject, so the verb must be 'has'.
explanation.id: 'Each' adalah inti subjek yang tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'has'.

en.introduction: Each blank follows a different rule. Identify the exact subject for each blank before choosing the verb.

rules.title: 1. Blank (i): Collective Noun as a Unit
rules.explanation: The pronoun 'its' shows that 'the committee' is treated as one body, so the verb is 'has'.
rules.structure: The committee + singular verb + its
notes: The committee has reached its decision.

rules.title: 2. Blank (ii): Each Of = Singular
rules.explanation: The subject is 'Each of the members'. The head word 'each' is singular, so the verb is 'has'.
rules.structure: Each of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Each of the members has prepared a report.

rules.title: 3. Blank (iii): Proximity with Neither... Nor
rules.explanation: The nearer subject is 'the treasurer' (singular), so the verb is 'was'.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the chairman nor the treasurer was able to attend.

common_mistakes.wrong: Assuming all three blanks need the same form.
common_mistakes.correct: Test each subject separately before choosing a verb.
common_mistakes.reason: The three clauses follow three different agreement rules.

other_examples.sentence: The board has approved its plan, and each of the directors has signed the document.
other_examples.translation: Dewan telah menyetujui rencananya, dan setiap direktur telah menandatangani dokumen itu.

explanation.en: 'The board' is a unit (has), and 'each of' is singular (has).
explanation.id: 'The board' adalah satu kesatuan (has), dan 'each of' bersifat tunggal (has).

questions.question: Which set of words correctly completes the passage?
questions.passage: Traffic in big cities ___ (i) ___ a serious problem. A number of commuters ___ (ii) ___ forced to spend hours on the road every day. The government, together with local authorities, ___ (iii) ___ trying to improve public transport.
questions.explanation: 'Traffic' is uncountable singular (is); 'a number of' means several (are); 'together with' does not change the singular subject 'the government' (is).
